international.title: Joanne Young’s faith in the justice system is a sign of real changes, but the courts are still catching up
international.summary: Years of reforms by prosecutors and police guided the approach that saw Young’s abusers convicted, though much more remains to be done Hope can be found in the darkest of places. Joanne Young stood outside Winchester crown court on Thursday and said she was relieved – not just for herself and her family – but for women in the future. Young, who was subjected to years of drugging and rape by her husband , who invited other men to assault her, waived her anonymity to speak out. Continue reading...
